title: Acme Expense Portal
success_evidence: An authenticated employee retrieves another synthetic employee's expense by changing the numeric object identifier.
root_cause: The vulnerable lookup authenticates the requester but does not verify that the requested expense belongs to that user.
mitigation: Apply object-level authorization after lookup and return the same not-found response for absent and unauthorized records.

juice_shop_reference.lesson: Transfer the ownership-check reasoning from Juice Shop access-control challenges to an unfamiliar API.
